<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

```python
get_family(name: str) -> FamilySpec
```

Part of [`evoxc_hf.families`](/api/evoxc-hf/families/)

Also available as `evoxc_hf.get_family`.

Look up a family by its `evoxc_hf` family key.

## Parameters

- `name` · `str` — the family key, e.g. `"llama"` or `"gpt2"` (this is
  `ModelConfig.family`, *not* an HF `model_type` — use
  `family_for_model_type` for that).

## Returns

- `FamilySpec` — the registry entry for `name`.

## Raises

- `HFUnsupportedError` — `name` is not a registered family; the message
  lists the supported families in sorted order.
